status: PASS for the transport/isolation scope; gateway activation, credentials and hardening remain M03/M04
authorization: operator deploy request; privileged steps entered by the operator

design.transport: worker socat UNIX-LISTEN -> sshd -i (inetd mode); no TCP listener and no loopback service
design.gateway_bridge: ProxyCommand runs bind-mounted Unix-socket bridge; the gateway image ships neither socat nor nc
design.enforcement: shims bind-mounted over /opt/hermes/bin/{ssh,scp,sftp}, first on the image PATH; OpenSSH first-wins option order defeats the backend's -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new
design.worker_host_key: persistent worker-only directory, not baked into the image, so rebuilds cannot change pinned identity
design.env_passthrough: worker sshd sets no AcceptEnv, so the gateway SSH passthrough stays empty

identity_finding.cause: gateway main-wrapper.sh drops the user command with s6-setuidgid hermes
consequences_fixed: /home/hermes/gateway-ssh must be 0711 so UID 10000 can traverse
the pinned private key must be owned by the mapped UID 10000 (host 599823) at mode 0600 because OpenSSH refuses group/world-readable keys
/home/hermes/transport must be 0711 and the socket 0666 for UID 10000 to connect
the worker account must not have an empty, '!' or '*' shadow field: with UsePAM no sshd rejects locked accounts for publickey too; a random non-matching value is used instead

validation.option_precedence: PASS - ssh -G with -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new reports stricthostkeychecking true
validation.positive_transport: PASS - output TRANSPORT_OK, user worker, Fedora release 44 (execution lands in the worker, not the Debian gateway)
validation.negative_changed_key: PASS - Host key for worker has changed and you have requested strict checking (rc 255)
validation.scp_round_trip: PASS - rc 0, remote file read back and SCP_OK

limitations: Gateway read-only root filesystem is not yet validated; the image bootstrap writes outside /opt/data
Resource limits are provisional (13 GiB host): gateway 2 GiB, worker 2 GiB, PID caps 256/512
